images.prompt: A white desk with an open plain notebook, one teal fountain pen, a pale yellow coffee cup and a small green potted plant, viewed from above with all objects separated. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The overhead photograph has one open blank notebook, a teal fountain pen, one coffee cup and one plant pot with clear natural materials and no writing or branding.

images.actual_source_analysis: An open blank cream notebook fills the lower center on a white desk. A teal fountain pen with a gold nib stands vertically to its right. One pale yellow cup of black coffee sits above right, and one leafy green potted plant sits above left. Soft diagonal daylight casts natural shadows; the page and tabletop have no text.
